_readme: Update feed registry for GenArchitect. Human-editable — this is the file you edit to add or drop a source.
Every feed here is AWS's own PUBLIC RSS. No API key, no scraping, no hidden endpoints.
To add a source: find its blog at https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/<slug>/ and use https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/<slug>/feed/
keepAll: true  -> every item is kept (only for feeds that are already on-topic).
keepAll: false -> an item must match the GenAI keyword filter in scripts/fetch-updates.mjs to survive.
Set active: false to mute a source without deleting it. See CURATION.md.
